column1: # sen_sero markers — one row per marker in the gspec/v1 panel.
# marker_id       gspec gene name (what a report shows)
# role            functional category written into the record's func slot
# serovar         serovar/group the marker was taken from (provenance, human)
# genome          INSDC accession the CDS was extracted from
# selector        gene=<symbol> or locus_tag=<tag> inside that genome
# phase           phase1 / phase2 / - : the flagellin locus synteny the builder
#                 verifies (phase1 = beside fliD/fliB, phase2 = beside hin/fljA)
# note            what the marker actually is (product + why it is here)
# Every selector is an annotated identifier, never a coordinate: the builder
# fails loudly when the symbol/tag disappears from the annotation, which is the
# signal that a reference accession needs re-curation.
